summary: Admit the official bounded 5Post pickup-point directory read through the reviewed runtime.

impacts.evidence: The existing registry resolves the account from authenticated tenant scope before invoking the reader.
Only normalized pickup-point fields cross the host boundary; API key and JWT stay callback-scoped.
The existing generic pickup-point route now admits 5Post through the registry.
No event envelope or event payload changes.
The existing fivepost PickupPointReader is composed into the builtin runtime.
The read uses existing account and operation boundaries without new persistence.
Fixed-host HTTPS, SecretProvider callback scope, response bounds and provider-neutral normalization remain mandatory.
The operation is read-only and does not alter the existing approval policy boundary.
No privileged mutation or audit schema change is introduced.
The provider rate-limited read uses the existing bounded route and no write retry is added.
The transport uses only the official 5Post API host and does not admit callbacks.
The shared HTTP timeout, response-size and retry-after handling remains in force.
Removing the fivepost registry branch or support capability immediately closes the read.
Deterministic JWT and pickup normalization tests verify the official route and boundary.
